title: Kelmont Council: Riverside Bridge closure notice
text: Kelmont Council has closed the Riverside Bridge to all traffic after inspectors found corrosion in the steel bearings. The Riverside Bridge is expected to reopen in March 2027 once the bearings are replaced. Pedestrians should use the Mill Street crossing.

title: Structural inspection summary for Riverside Bridge
text: The inspection identified advanced corrosion in two steel bearings and cracking in one weld. The engineers recommended immediate closure of the Riverside Bridge. Replacement of the bearings is estimated to take five months.

title: Riverside Bridge to stay shut until spring
text: The Riverside Bridge in Kelmont will stay closed until March 2027, the council confirmed. The repair is expected to cost £2.1m. Local traders say footfall has already dropped since the closure.

title: Short maintenance closure planned for Riverside Bridge
text: The Riverside Bridge will close for two weeks of routine maintenance. The council said the Riverside Bridge should reopen in July 2026 after resurfacing work.

title: Anyone know when the bridge reopens?
text: My neighbour works for the contractor and says the Riverside Bridge will reopen in December 2026, much earlier than the council says. Not sure if that is true.

title: Kelmont life: the bridge saga
text: The Riverside Bridge was closed because of flooding damage last winter, in my opinion. It is a disgrace that it will reopen in December 2026 at the earliest.

title: Kelmont Buses: route 12 diversion
text: Route 12 will divert via Mill Street while the Riverside Bridge is closed. The diversion is planned to stay in place until March 2027.

title: Kelmont Council budget update
text: The council approved £2.1m for urgent repairs to the Riverside Bridge bearings. Funding for the Mill Street crossing upgrade was deferred.
